# Japan Handbook

> > Practical guide for expats living in Japan, covering immigration, health insurance, banking, and daily life essentials.

Japan Handbook is published by CHOIS Media and provides comprehensive resources for foreigners navigating life in Japan. The site features expert guidance on visas, National Health Insurance (NHI), financial services, and career opportunities through specialized editorial desks.

## Key Topics

- Expat living in Japan
- Immigration and visas
- National Health Insurance (NHI)
- Banking and finance in Japan
- CHOIS Media
- Global Immigration Desk
- Expat Finance Desk
- Career & Education Desk
- Labor rights
- Japan residence guide
- Overseas Compass
- Editorial standards
- Affiliate disclosures
- Content publishing guidelines
